macros.name: forallpeople

macros.name: foreachperson
macros.doc: Iterates through the list of people and, at each iteration, assigns ⟨name-cs⟩ to the person’s name, ⟨full-name-cs⟩ to the person’s full name, ⟨gender-cs⟩ to the language-sensitive gender text, and ⟨label-cs⟩ to the person’s label, and then does ⟨body⟩.
